title: Vampire Vape Vanilla Tobacco 10ml E-Liquid
description: If you’re a vaper who goes for classic e-juice flavours why not branch out and try new flavours with this sublime e-juice. Vampire Vape Vanilla Tobacco E-Liquid is a rich, earthy tobacco flavour that has been mellowed to perfection with the addition of warm, creamy notes of Vanilla. Vampire Vape’s delicious Vanilla Tobacco E-Liquid offers a delightfully smooth and endlessly satisfying tobacco blend that is made irresistible with the delicate spicy sweetness of vanilla. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
